notes.title: Update 1.4.2976 Released
notes.content: This is a small maintenance release which updates the engine libraries with bug fixes and performance improvements. It also make some small changes to the menu artwork. Happy mowing!

notes.title: Mow Problem 1.3.2970 Released for Windows and macOS
notes.content:
A small patch to address some user reported issues:
[list]
[*] Fix text overlapping in pause menu
[*] Fix not being able to get 100% score on Summer 02
[*] Increased distance awarded per tile significantly - the 500 Mile achievement should be far less grind now...
[*] Undocked nodes are removed when a program is run, so this can't be exploited in time trial any more.
[/list]

Thanks for playing, happy mowing!

notes.title: Build 1.2.2960 for macOS and Windows released
notes.content:
This is a small update addressing some feedback about the UI - for instance there is now a button above the toolbox to open the menu.

The Windows build has also been tested to work on Proton, so linux users can now get busy with the shears too! Any machine with the same spec as the minimum required windows spec should work fine. It has been tested on arch and ubuntu 18. Please feel free to try it out and share your experiences. It should be noted, however, that this is NOT official linux support.

Happy mowing :D

notes.title: Update 1.1.2947 Released for macOS and Windows
notes.content: This is a small update which fixes the achievement 'Braved the Weather' being awarded when completing the Autumn maps. Sorry about that! We've also had a lot of positive feedback, as well as a few suggestions so some of those will be implemented in a future update coming soon. Thank you for playing, happy mowing!

notes.title: It's here!
notes.content: A big Thank You to everyone who has supported me during development, and let's not forget the talented @RyanMusicCo for providing the sound track. Grab the game now while it has a 15% launch discount! See you on the leaderboards...

notes.title: Hello!
notes.content: Thank you for checking out Mow Problem! We're busy beavering away to get it ready for release right now... we hope you'll like it!
